posts.title: App Store Award Finalists
posts.description: Apple Newsroom Today, Apple announced 45 finalists for this year’s App Store Awards, celebrating developers from around the world whose apps and games exemplify the very best in technical innovation, user experience, and design. This year’s finalists span iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Vision Pro, Apple Watch, Apple TV, and Apple Arcade, as well as the Cultural Impact category. Winners will be announced
Ahhh, kitty life is a rough life in the Fahrni household. Laying around on their human servants and comfy blankets all day. But, I suppose, someone has to make that sacrifice.
Modern Infrastructure Sorry, y’all, I had to share it. 😃
